meta.title: Custom Report Builder: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role on the specified Enterprise tenant
Use Custom Report Builder to create reports with custom fields and formulas
Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and compare availability or refusal
Verify the tenant's Enterprise plan and record deliberate RBAC configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role on the specified Enterprise tenant; Use Custom Report Builder to create reports with custom fields and formulas; Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and compare availability or refusal; Verify the tenant's Enterprise plan and record deliberate RBAC configuration

args.need: provide access to the same Enterprise tenant as both a non-Tenant-Admin user and a Tenant Admin, then compare whether each can open Custom Report Builder and build a report with custom fields and formulas

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch user roles or operate or observe Custom Report Builder.
Final assertion confirming the delegated session did not end with a visible application error; it does not establish the RBAC outcome.
